#
from numpy import floor

def mergesort(arr, lb, ub):
	if (lb < ub):  #
		mid = int(floor((lb + ub) / 2))
		mergesort(arr, lb, mid)
		mergesort(arr, mid + 1, ub)
		aux_arr = merge(arr, lb, mid, ub)

def merge(arr, lb, mid, ub):
	aux_arr = []  #
	i = lb
	j = mid + 1

	while (i <= mid and j <= ub):
		if (arr[i] < arr[j]):
			aux_arr.append(arr[i])
			i += 1
		else:
			aux_arr.append(arr[j])
			j += 1

	while (i <= mid):  #
		aux_arr.append(arr[i])
		i += 1

	while (j <= ub):
		aux_arr.append(arr[j])
		j += 1

	i = lb
	j = 0
	while (i <= ub):
		#
		arr[i] = aux_arr[j]
		i += 1
		j += 1

array = [int(x) for x in input("Enter an array of numbers (Space separated): ").split()]
mergesort(array, 0, len(array) - 1)
print("Merge-sorted Array: ", *array, sep=" ")

def quicksort(arr, lb, ub):
	if (lb < ub):  #
		prev_pivot = partition(arr, lb, ub)
		quicksort(arr, lb, prev_pivot - 1)
		quicksort(arr, prev_pivot + 1, ub)


def partition(arr, lb, ub):
	start = lb
	end = ub
	#
	pivot = arr[lb]
	#

	while (start < end):
		#
		while (start < (len(arr) - 1) and arr[start] <= pivot):
			start += 1

		while (arr[end] > pivot):
			end -= 1

		if (start < end):
			arr[end], arr[start] = arr[start], arr[end]

	if (arr.index(pivot) != end):  #
		arr[end], arr[lb] = arr[lb], arr[end]

	return end  #


array = []
x = 0
while (x != -1):
	x = int(input("Enter array element, (-1 to stop): "))
	if (x != -1):
		array.append(x)

quicksort(array, 0, len(array) - 1)

print("\nQuicksorted array:", end=' ')
for i in array:
	print(i, end=' ')
